name: Picture frame
blurb: A frame for a 5 × 7 photo. A great gift.

steps.text: Cut two rails 11-1/2 inches long and two stiles 4-1/2 inches long from the 1x3.
Glue the stiles between the rails and clamp the frame flat and square.
Set a mending plate across each corner on the back and tap a small nail into each screw hole to make a starter (pilot) hole.
When the glue is dry, screw a flat mending plate across each corner on the back.
Sand and finish, then tape the photo to the back.
